sentences.text: FDA first posted the ketorolac tromethamine injection shortage on 2018-03-23 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.

Multiple manufacturers are listed on the FDA shortage list including Alembic Pharmaceuticals, Baxter Healthcare, Fresenius Kabi USA, Gland Pharma Limited, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Hospira Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals.
Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) is a registered plant on the product label for NDC 00409379601.
FDA inspection 976095 at this plant ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 653 days before the shortage posting on 2018-03-23.
A Warning Letter was issued to this plant on 2017-02-14, 402 days before the shortage posting.
FDA inspection 1064827 at the same plant ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, 145 days after the shortage posting.
The best option by rule is to buy from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
